title: Foundational ADR set for pluggable cognitive memory
decision_scope: Binding architecture decisions required before the M0 go/no-go gate and implementation milestones M1 through M6.

decisions.title: Place the capability-based provider boundary above Native fact-store contracts
decisions.decision_summary: Providers implement versioned capabilities above TraceDecay application ports. TraceDecay Native remains the explicit-fact authority; cognitive providers return advisory recall and receive observations/outcomes without implementing ProjectMemoryFactStore.
required_rejections: Direct `ProjectMemoryFactStore` implementation
provider-name branching

decisions.title: Keep TraceDecay authorities canonical and provider memory advisory
decisions.decision_summary: Current code, exact scope identity, sessions, accepted Native facts, curated rules, and final context assembly remain TraceDecay-owned. Provider candidates are labelled, scope-bound, provenance-bearing advisory evidence with no implicit promotion.
required_rejections: provider recall as canonical truth
implicit promotion into Native facts

decisions.title: Isolate provider contracts, fabric, adapters, context, and conformance in product-owned crates
decisions.decision_summary: Use additive product-owned crates with inward provider contracts, provider-neutral orchestration/context, isolated Native and NCM adapters, and mechanical dependency guards. Only the narrow registry/composition layer constructs concrete adapters.
required_rejections: Put provider logic in the root `tracedecay` crate
provider-name branching

decisions.title: Keep provider contracts topology-neutral and defer the first NCM topology decision
decisions.decision_summary: The provider protocol supports in-process and isolated local-process adapters behind one lifecycle contract. Native starts in-process. NCM topology remains deliberately undecided until the licensed surface audit and an ADR-backed selection evaluate crash isolation, latency, cancellation, state ownership, and reuse.

allowed_candidates: another bounded topology proved by the surface audit

required_rejections: Choose in-process NCM immediately
Mandate one execution topology for every provider

decisions.title: Use separate provider state plus a bounded durable observation outbox
decisions.decision_summary: TraceDecay owns a durable bounded observation journal and delivery receipts; each provider instance owns only its internal state. Delivery is at-least-once with stable idempotency, typed partial effects, bounded retries/backpressure, replay, and explicit privacy/retention.
required_rejections: unbounded in-memory queue
provider state in Native fact tables

decisions.title: Compile final coding context in TraceDecay from separately admitted authority lanes
decisions.decision_summary: TraceDecay alone assembles final request-scoped context. Current code, policy, Native facts, session evidence, and provider candidates remain separate lanes with exact scope, provenance, freshness, deterministic normalization, budgets, and typed per-lane degradation.
required_rejections: provider-built final context
Compare raw scores across providers

decisions.title: Make observer mode mechanically non-influential and active mode explicitly gated
decisions.decision_summary: Observer providers receive post-commit observations and may emit inspection/evaluation traces, but no value reachable from observer execution can affect prompts, canonical state, tools, approvals, or externally visible actions. Active recall requires explicit configuration and conformance/evaluation gates.
required_rejections: best-effort isolation by convention
implicit provider activation

decisions.title: Converge with upstream through additive product ownership, mapped exceptions, and isolated sync trains
decisions.decision_summary: The immutable product floor advances only through isolated, reviewable sync trains. Product-owned crates and artifacts stay additive; every existing upstream-file edit is budgeted and mapped with semantic invariants, tests, rationale, and a removal/rebase plan. Exceptions require an ADR before the edit.
required_rejections: continuous unreviewed rebases
unmapped upstream-owned edits

decisions.title: Run each NCM exact scope in a supervised isolated local process
decisions.decision_summary: The selected design requires one supervised Biomem process and provider-owned state directory per exact scope behind NcmCognitiveSurface and private loopback HTTP. The enforced child boundary must deny TraceDecay database, repository, credential, and raw identity authority; restart invalidates readiness while durable operation evidence survives reconciliation. Production remains blocked on exact-scope isolation plus the audited identity, cancellation/effect, deduplication, persistence, and supervisor gaps.
required_rejections: in-process Biomem integration
MCP stdio as the provider transport

decisions.title: Project Native behavior through the provider boundary with explicit semantic parity
decisions.decision_summary: Compare direct and provider-routed Native behavior through semantic goldens that preserve fact identity, content, order, fixed-point scores, explanations, provenance, current validity, and typed no-effect failures while documenting exact-scope, read-only recall, temporal, lifecycle, and envelope non-equivalences.
required_rejections: Compare the complete provider envelope byte-for-byte with direct Native output
Treat the provider exact-scope envelope as a Native project/profile owner
Record Native retrieval telemetry during provider recall
Allow provider feedback to update Native trust

decisions.title: Revise the patch-footprint policy to v2 for the mounted memory milestones
decisions.decision_summary: Adopt policy revision patch-footprint.v2, setting each hard upstream cap to the footprint measured at the revision tree plus at most roughly fifteen percent headroom, while leaving allowed touch points, exception zones, product-owned paths, dependency rules, and per-entry line budgets unchanged.
required_rejections: Leave the v1 caps and let the gate fail
Raise the caps far above the measurement to avoid future ADRs
Move the mounts into product-owned crates to stay inside v1
Delete the per-entry line budgets and keep only the aggregate caps

decisions.title: Register memory-provider settings in the upstream configuration registry as a bounded exception
decisions.decision_summary: Grant a two-file, additive-only exception in the native_database_internals zone so the upstream configuration registry can declare memory.provider_native_enabled.v1 and the recall-routing setting with a disabled default, a daemon-restart requirement, and additive reconciliation for existing profiles.
required_rejections: Read the memory settings from a product-owned side table instead of the registry
Fork the configuration registry into a product-owned crate
Hard-code the provider composition as always-on and drop the settings
Gate the provider on an environment variable or build feature only

decisions.title: Approve the daemon shutdown touch point at six files and 320 changed lines
decisions.decision_summary: Approve the daemon_shutdown_deadline touch point at 6 files and 320 changed lines, admitting crates/tracedecay-daemon-service/src/invocation/types.rs as the sixth path so the LSP lease registry can retire its tasks under the caller's absolute deadline. No ADR-0011 aggregate cap changes; touch-point caps become pinned in the checker and a revised cap must be bound to this ADR.
required_rejections: Bundle the cap increase into the implementation change
Amend ADR-0011 to exempt local touch-point caps
Raise the cap to the global per-category limit

decisions.title: Revise the patch-footprint policy to v3 for the Claude Code host hook ingest journey
decisions.decision_summary: Adopt policy revision patch-footprint.v3: raise upstream existing production files 34 -> 37, total upstream changed lines 3300 -> 3500, and exception-zone files 2 -> 4, each set from the measured tree (37 files, 3393 lines, 4 exception-zone files) plus at most roughly fifteen percent headroom; approve the host_hook_ingest touch point at 3 files and 200 changed lines; approve a two-file host_specific_adapters exception for the Claude hook adapter; and classify crates/tracedecay-cli/tests/product_memory_provider_*.rs as product-owned. Every other v2 cap, zone, dependency rule, and per-entry line budget is unchanged.
required_rejections: Wait for the daemon's own session-sync sweep instead of ingesting at the hook boundary
Add a product-owned hook binary or host adapter beside the upstream one
Widen the profile-scoped Claude kernel to also cover registered projects
Make the catch-up ingest blocking or unbounded so no frame can be missed
Leave the v2 caps and let the gate fail
Raise the caps far above the measurement to avoid future ADRs
